687-3862-4050-4613-8130.description:
Cast Orcish Bowmasters by paying its mana cost; it enters with a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
When Orcish Bowmasters enters, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target and creating a 0/0 creature token with a +1/+1 counter on it as well as a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
Declare that you are activating Tayam's ability, so state-based actions will not be checked until the ability is activated.
While paying that ability's cost, activate the creature token using the Wall of Roots mana ability from Agatha's Soul Cauldron by putting a -0/-1 counter on it, adding {G}.
Complete the activation by paying {3} and removing a vigilance counter from each of the two creatures and a -0/-1 counter from the Army token.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Orcish Bowmasters and the creature token, adding two mana.
Resolve Tayam's ability, milling three and returning Orcish Bowmasters from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.
687-3862-4050-4613-8130.notes: This order of operations (and the additional {2} starting mana) are necessary because you must activate mana abilities before paying costs, and so you cannot use Ashnod's Altar to get mana from the creature you need to remove counters from.

Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.

Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling the mana producing permanent(s) and Repository Skaab and creating that many 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
